request: 设备申请名称自动换成我的设备码
acceptance: An admitted plugin call reads the existing Aide device code via api.deviceInfo().
Only available/code are returned; no identity creation, message enablement, contacts, messages, keys or full fingerprints.
The capability remains local to the invocation and rejects reads after lock generation changes.
Real Node plugin-host integration and targeted Go race tests pass with synthetic device identities.

requirements.summary: User asks device-request name to match the Aide device code automatically. Code is a display label, not license binding.

design.summary: Expose existing public display metadata through api.deviceInfo() and the admitted per-call Unix channel. Do not create an identity or enable messaging.

implementation.summary: Added api.deviceInfo(), capability marker, read-only code lookup and protocol docs.

verification.summary: Quick gate passed; targeted server tests and real Node host passed, including lock revocation; targeted server race tests passed. Existing optional source-comparison bundle tests remain conditional.

documentation.summary: Plugin protocol documents two-field result, old-host compatibility and the non-authoritative display-code boundary.

cleanup.summary: Reviewed scoped files in isolated worktree; original checkout and user data retained.

release.summary: Preparing a source PR; no Aide formal release or production restart requested in this change.

handoff: Consumers may use the existing name fallback on older hosts. Device codes are labels, not identity or authorization credentials.
